Shabnam speaks Marathi. Anil speaks Tamil. Both Rekha and David can drive. Which of the following statements is true?
questions.answer: One of those who can drive a car speaks Tamil.

questions.subject: logical reasoning
questions.text:
In a plane, line X is perpendicular to line Y and parallel to line Z; line U is perpendicular to both lines V and W; line X is perpendicular to line V. 

Which one of the following statements is correct?
questions.answer: Y, V and W are parallel

questions.subject: quantitative aptitude
questions.text: A cow costs more than 4 goats but less than 5 goats. If a goat costs between Rs. 600 and Rs. 800, which of the following is a most valid conclusion?
questions.answer: A cow costs between Rs. 2,400 and Rs. 4,000

questions.subject: logical reasoning
questions.text:
A society consists of only two types of people fighters and cowards. Two cowards are always friends. A fighter and a coward are always enemies. Fighters are indifferent to one another. If A and B are enemies, C and D are friends, E and F are indifferent to each other, A and E are not enemies, while B and F are enemies. 

Which of the following statements is correct?
questions.answer: A, E and F are fighters

questions.subject: quantitative aptitude
questions.text: In a box of marbles, there are three less white marbles than the red ones and five more white marbles than the green ones. If there are a total of 10 white marbles, how many marbles are there in the box?

questions.subject: quantitative aptitude
questions.text: Candidates in a competitive examination consisted of 60% men and 40% women. 70% men and 75% women cleared the qualifying test and entered the final test where 80% men and 70% women were successful. Which of the following statements is correct?
questions.answer: More men cleared the examination than women

questions.subject: logical reasoning
questions.text: Consider the following statements followed by two conclusions: Statements: Some men are great. Some men are wise. Conclusion I: Men are either great or wise. Conclusion II: Some men are neither great nor wise Which one of the following is correct?
